name: Cosmos Club
source:
Main character is a freshman student who gets to enter a student dormitory "Cosmos club" full of girls. He is secretly in love with one of the girls and seeks her attention.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名大学新生，得以住进名为“宇宙俱乐部”的学生宿舍，里面住的全是女孩。他暗恋着其中一人，并想方设法吸引她的注意。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
